claim: Explicit first-order laws with independent behavioral controls; this is not a proof of an independent minimal basis.

laws.rule: Equal atoms agree; equal-arity lists generate corresponding child equations; differing atoms, constructors or arities clash.
A free variable may be consistently bound to a term only when the variable does not occur in that term after dereferencing.
Resolve existing variable bindings and preserve their identity across all equations of the same clause instance.
Every attempted clause use receives a fresh variable scope; repeated occurrences within that head and body share the same cells.
Unify the leftmost goal with a fresh clause head and replace it by that clause's ordered premises; explore further source clauses after failure.
Observe the instantiated query after all remaining goals have been discharged.
An equation with a free variable on the right can be oriented to put it on the left.
Conservative head filtering, immutable ground-term normalization and conditional undo logging preserve the same unification and ordered resolution relation.

minimalityGap: Removing each operation group blocks the workload, but the groups contain several laws and some are derivable or administrative. No independent residual-law minimality or information-content comparison with the S/K equations is established.
scopeGap: The generic host unifier and SLD dispatcher are still an external boundary, even though a replaceable linked unifier and dispatcher interpret the upper source image above them.
